newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Corp up on quest for blue-chips.
newsitem.headline: Sony Corp up on quest for blue-chips.

text.p: Sony Corp shares were higher in early morning trade on Thursday on continued interest in global issues, brokers said.
As of 0022 GMT, the shares were up 210 yen at 7,680 yen, with 4.96 million shares traded.

On Tuesday, before a national holiday, videogame software maker Enix Corp said it would develop and supply the latest version of one of its best-selling videogame software packages, "Dragon Quest VII", for Sony's 32-bit game player PlayStation.
Media reports on Wednesday said Enix, which in the past supplied Nintendo Co Ltd with Dragon Quest software, would develop the new version especially for Sony.
The reports could not immediately be confirmed.
